description:
Establish a green baseline before injecting anything. If the harness is flaky with no chaos, every chaos result afterward is meaningless.

Builds on the peer cluster from bedrock-80f.

- A workload driver running transactions against the peer cluster via Bedrock.Repo, with configurable concurrency and key distribution. Must live in compiled test/support, not a .exs file: peers inherit the primary's code paths but .exs is only evaluated in the primary VM, so a closure built in a test file has no module on the peer.
- An external journal of every acked commit, written as it happens, so evidence survives a wedged or killed cluster.
- The conservation workload: transfers across N accounts whose total is invariant at every snapshot version. Catches lost writes, torn transactions, and MVCC violations without needing any fault at all.
- Oracles run against a fault-free run and must be green and repeatable before the next child starts.

Exit criterion: sustained workload against a 3-node peer cluster, all oracles green, repeatable across consecutive runs.
title: Workload driver and acked-commit journal, with zero faults
